name: Plesiosaurus
descr: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.

data.motivesAndTactics: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully

features.name: Only a Rumor
features.text: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can't be located or targeted.

features.name: Wall of Water
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take **3d10** physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.
